_meta.description: Hand-written evaluation set for the NL->SQL pipeline. Each item carries a gold SQL query and the gold table set so retrieval recall and execution accuracy can be measured separately. gold_sql is a reference answer; for aggregate/ordering questions other equivalent formulations may also be correct, so compare on RESULT SET, not string match.
_meta.value_repair_note: Items with "tests": "value_repair" use a natural-language term that does NOT match the literal stored in the column (e.g. 'HR' vs 'Human Resources'). They are designed to make a naive generator return 0 rows so the value-grounding repair layer is exercised.
_meta.status: DRAFT - gold_sql NOT yet validated against a live instance. Run the validator before trusting these.

b1.prompt: List all departments along with the group they belong to.

b2.prompt: How many products are there in total?
b2.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ProductCount FROM Production.Product;

b3.prompt: Show the name and list price of the 10 most expensive products.
b3.gold_sql: SELECT TOP 10 Name, ListPrice FROM Production.Product ORDER BY ListPrice DESC;

b4.prompt: List the first name, last name and job title of all employees.
b4.gold_sql: SELECT p.FirstName, p.LastName, e.JobTitle FROM HumanResources.Employee e JOIN Person.Person p ON e.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID;

m1.prompt: What is the total sales amount (TotalDue) for each calendar year?
m1.gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(OrderDate) AS OrderYear, SUM(TotalDue) AS TotalSales FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader GROUP BY YEAR(OrderDate) ORDER BY OrderYear;

m2.prompt: How many employees currently work in each department? (use the current assignment only)
m2.gold_sql: SELECT d.Name AS DepartmentName, COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount FROM HumanResources.Department d JOIN HumanResources.EmployeeDepartmentHistory edh ON d.DepartmentID = edh.DepartmentID WHERE edh.EndDate IS NULL GROUP BY d.Name ORDER BY EmployeeCount DESC;

m3.prompt: List all employees who work in the Human Resources department.
m3.gold_sql: SELECT p.FirstName, p.LastName, e.JobTitle FROM HumanResources.Employee e JOIN Person.Person p ON e.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID JOIN HumanResources.EmployeeDepartmentHistory edh ON e.BusinessEntityID = edh.BusinessEntityID JOIN HumanResources.Department d ON edh.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID WHERE d.Name = 'Human Resources' AND edh.EndDate IS NULL;
m3.value_repair_hint: A naive model will likely filter d.Name = 'HR'; the stored value is 'Human Resources'.

m4.prompt: Show all products in the 'Mountain Bikes' subcategory with their list price.
m4.gold_sql: SELECT p.Name, p.ListPrice FROM Production.Product p JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID WHERE ps.Name = 'Mountain Bikes';

m5.prompt: Count how many customers are assigned to each sales territory.
m5.gold_sql: SELECT st.Name AS TerritoryName, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Sales.Customer c JOIN Sales.SalesTerritory st ON c.TerritoryID = st.TerritoryID GROUP BY st.Name ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC;

m6.prompt: List the names of all female employees.
m6.gold_sql: SELECT p.FirstName, p.LastName FROM HumanResources.Employee e JOIN Person.Person p ON e.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID WHERE e.Gender = 'F';
m6.value_repair_hint: Gender is stored as a single char 'F'/'M', not 'Female'/'Male'.

h1.prompt: Who are the top 5 customers by total amount spent across all their orders?
h1.gold_sql: SELECT TOP 5 soh.CustomerID, SUM(soh.TotalDue) AS TotalSpent FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader soh GROUP BY soh.CustomerID ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC;

h2.prompt: Which product has been sold in the highest total quantity?
h2.gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 p.Name, SUM(sod.OrderQty) AS TotalQty FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail sod JOIN Production.Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.Name ORDER BY TotalQty DESC;

h3.prompt: List products that have never been ordered by customers.
h3.gold_sql: SELECT p.ProductID, p.Name FROM Production.Product p LEFT JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail sod ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID WHERE sod.ProductID IS NULL;

h4.prompt: For each sales person, show their first/last name and their total sales (TotalDue) for orders they handled.
h4.gold_sql: SELECT p.FirstName, p.LastName, SUM(soh.TotalDue) AS TotalSales FROM Sales.SalesPerson sp JOIN Person.Person p ON sp.BusinessEntityID = p.BusinessEntityID JOIN Sales.SalesOrderHeader soh ON sp.BusinessEntityID = soh.SalesPersonID GROUP BY p.FirstName, p.LastName ORDER BY TotalSales DESC;

h5.prompt: What is the average order total (TotalDue) per month in 2013?
h5.gold_sql: SELECT MONTH(OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, AVG(TotalDue) AS AvgOrderTotal FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2013 GROUP BY MONTH(OrderDate) ORDER BY OrderMonth;

h6.prompt: List the top 3 product subcategories by total revenue (LineTotal).
h6.gold_sql: SELECT TOP 3 ps.Name AS Subcategory, SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS Revenue FROM Sales.SalesOrderDetail sod JOIN Production.Product p ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryID = ps.ProductSubcategoryID GROUP BY ps.Name ORDER BY Revenue DESC;
